phases.title: Survival
phases.goal: Read and write the Arabic script and handle greetings, numbers, and basic self-introduction.
can: Recognize and write all 28 Arabic letters in their initial, medial, and final forms
Read short fully-voweled words using the harakat (fatḥa, kasra, ḍamma, sukūn)
Apply the definite article ال and hear the sun/moon-letter difference (ash-shams vs al-qamar)
Exchange greetings: as-salāmu ʿalaykum, ṣabāḥ al-khayr, kayfa ḥāluk, maʿa as-salāma
Count 1–20 and read the Eastern Arabic numerals ٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩
Introduce yourself with a nominal sentence: anā... , ismī... , anā min...
phases.daily: 15 min tracing/reading the alphabet, 10 min flashcards for greetings and numbers, 5 min listening to spoken Arabic to tune your ear (30 min/day).

phases.title: Foundation
phases.goal: Build core vocabulary and form simple present-tense and nominal sentences with correct gender agreement.
can: Mark and use grammatical gender, adding ة for feminine nouns and adjectives
Build nominal sentences with no verb 'to be' (al-bayt kabīr)
Conjugate the present tense (المضارع) for anā/anta/huwa/hiya/naḥnu
Attach possessive suffixes: kitābī, kitābuka, baytuhā, baytunā
Ask and answer questions with hal, mā, ayna, matā, kam
Use demonstratives hādhā/hādhihi/dhālika/tilka with agreement
phases.daily: 20 min structured lessons (grammar + gender), 10 min vocab (family, food, colors), 10 min speaking simple sentences aloud (40 min/day).

phases.title: Core Structures
phases.goal: Command past, present, and future tenses and the key sentence structures of Modern Standard Arabic.
can: Conjugate the past tense (الماضي) across all persons (katabtu, katabta, katabat, katabnā)
Form the future with the prefix سـ and سَوْفَ
Negate correctly in every tense with lā, lam (+jussive), lan (+subjunctive), and laysa
Build the iḍāfa possessive construct (bāb al-bayt, sayyārat al-mudīr)
Form the imperative (uktub, iqraʾ, idhhab) and its negative with lā
Handle the dual form and both sound and common broken plurals
phases.daily: 20 min verb-tense drills, 15 min reading short voweled texts, 10 min writing 3–4 sentences, 10 min review (55 min/day).

phases.title: Fluency
phases.goal: Express complex ideas with subordinate clauses, the case system, and the derived verb forms.
can: Use أَنْ + subjunctive after urīd, yajib, and yumkin (urīdu an ataʿallama)
Master كان وأخواتها and إنّ وأخواتها with the accusative case they govern
Build relative clauses with alladhī/allatī/alladhīna on definite nouns
Recognize and use derived verb Forms II, III, V, VII, VIII, and X
Read unvoweled prose and infer the short vowels from context
Handle conditional sentences with idhā and law and comparative/superlative أَفْعَل
phases.daily: 20 min reading news or graded readers, 15 min listening to Al Jazeera/podcasts, 15 min writing a paragraph, 10 min vocabulary in context (60 min/day).

phases.title: Mastery
phases.goal: Use Arabic naturally across formal registers, with full command of grammar, style, and rhetoric.
can: Apply full case endings (iʿrāb) accurately in speech and formal writing
Use the maṣdar (verbal noun) and active/passive participles idiomatically
Command the passive voice (المبني للمجهول) and the internal-vowel patterns it requires
Read classical and literary texts, including Qurʾanic and poetic language
Write formal essays, emails, and reports with cohesive connectors and rhetoric
Switch appropriately between MSA (fuṣḥā) and a regional dialect (ʿāmmiyya)
phases.daily: 30 min reading literature or specialist texts, 20 min writing/editing, 15 min discussion or shadowing native audio, ongoing dialect immersion (65 min/day).
